query: SELECT h.parent, p.main_id AS parent_id, p.otype AS parent_otype, p.nbref AS parent_nbref, h.child, c.main_id AS child_id, c.otype AS child_otype, c.nbref AS child_nbref FROM h_link AS h JOIN basic AS p ON p.oid = h.parent JOIN basic AS c ON c.oid = h.child WHERE h.parent = 14743763 OR h.child = 14743763
